newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank says baht stability a priority.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank says baht stability a priority.

text.p: Ensuring stability of the Thai baht remains a top priority for the Bank of Thailand, central bank Governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Saturday.
"We regard the baht's stability as the last bastion which has to be defended," he told a meeting of the Association of Finance Companies at this Thai resort town.
The Bank of Thailand's robust defence of the baht against speculative attacks earlier this year had brought stability to the currency but not allowed the bank to address other issues, Rerngchai said.
"Now the baht has gained stability leaving us room to look at other issues," he said.
"Had the Bank of Thailand not stood firm in defending the baht we would have lost the battle and we may not be able to meet here like this today," he added.
High interest rates would be maintained to help ensure the currency's stability, he said.
The minimum lending rate at Thai commercial banks is currently above 13 percent.
"Some of the measures may be bitter pills but are in the interests of future stability," he said.
